parameters.query: SELECT COALESCE(p.policy_id, 'NONE') AS policy_id, COALESCE(p.max_value_per_tx_usd, 0) AS max_value_per_tx_usd, COALESCE(p.hourly_velocity_limit_usd, 0) AS hourly_velocity_limit_usd, COALESCE(p.daily_spending_limit_usd, 0) AS daily_spending_limit_usd, COALESCE(p.human_approval_threshold_usd, 0) AS human_approval_threshold_usd, COALESCE((SELECT json_agg(LOWER(a.target_contract)) FROM agentic_guard.allowlists a WHERE a.policy_id = p.policy_id), '[]'::json) AS allowed_contracts FROM (SELECT '{{ .policyId }}' AS req_policy_id) req LEFT JOIN agentic_guard.policies p ON p.policy_id = req.req_policy_id AND p.is_active = TRUE;
